newsitem.title: USA: Westcoast says B.C. gas plant back on line.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast says B.C. gas plant back on line.

text.p: Westcoast Energy said Monday that its Fort Nelson, British Columbia, natural gas processing plant had returned to full operation yesterday.

"I can confirm that the Fort Nelson plant is back on line. Effective yesterday, June 22, the plant was reopened. As of this morning, it was processing about 425 mmcfd (million cubic feet per day)," a company spokesman said.
He said all firm contract volumes were now being met.

The plant, which has a rated capacity of 750 mmcfd and had been shut for scheduled maintenance since June 10, restarted Thursday but was shut again early Friday and a force majeure was declared because of problems with the quality of gas being delivered to the plant.
